lit: Patience is the key to relief.
en: Hang in there — good things come to those who wait.

lit: Whoever strives, finds.
en: Hard work pays off.

ar: في التأني السلامة وفي العجلة الندامة
lit: In patience there is safety, and in haste regret.
en: Haste makes waste.

ar: الوقت كالسيف إن لم تقطعه قطعك
say: al-WAQT kas-SAYF in lam taq-ta'-HU qa-TA-'ak
lit: Time is like a sword: if you don't cut it, it cuts you.
en: Use your time well — it waits for no one.

lit: One hand doesn't clap.
en: It takes teamwork.

lit: The neighbor before the house.
en: Choose your neighbors before you choose your home.

lit: A friend is for the time of hardship.
en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

ar: الكلام من فضة والسكوت من ذهب
say: al-ka-LAAM min FID-da was-su-KOOT min DHA-hab
lit: Speech is of silver and silence is of gold.
en: Silence is golden.

lit: For every situation, its own words.
en: There's a time and a place for everything.

lit: To its mother, the monkey is a gazelle.
en: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.

say: KHAYR al-ka-LAAM maa QALL wa DALL
lit: The best speech is short and to the point.
en: Less is more.

ar: لا تؤجل عمل اليوم إلى الغد
lit: Don't put off today's work until tomorrow.
en: Don't put off till tomorrow what you can do today.

lit: Every delay has some good in it.
en: Everything happens for a reason.

lit: Stretch your legs only as far as your blanket.
en: Live within your means.

lit: Movement is a blessing.
en: Keep moving — staying active is good for you.

lit: What has passed has died.
en: Let bygones be bygones.

lit: Seek knowledge, even in China.
en: Go to any lengths to learn.

lit: A sound mind is in a sound body.
en: Healthy body, healthy mind.

ar: ما كل ما يتمنى المرء يدركه
lit: Not everything a person wishes for, he attains. (al-Mutanabbi)
en: You can't always get what you want.

ar: اللي بيته من زجاج ما يرمي الناس بالحجارة
say: il-LEE BAY-tuh min zu-JAAJ maa YIR-mee in-NAAS bil-Hi-JAA-ra
lit: Whoever's house is made of glass shouldn't throw stones at people.
en: People in glass houses shouldn't throw stones.

ar: إذا كنت في روما فافعل كما يفعل الرومان
say: i-DHA kun-ta fee ROO-ma fa-F'AL KA-maa YAF-'al ar-roo-MAAN
lit: If you are in Rome, do as the Romans do.
en: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.

lit: Ask someone experienced, not someone wise.
en: Experience beats theory.
